summary: Practise workplace conflict diagnosis, feedback and follow-through with usable conversation plans. Explore the five-day conflict management course.
lede: Conflict management training helps supervisors, HR practitioners and project leads address everyday workplace disputes through structured conversations. Learners practise spotting escalation, separating observable facts from assumptions, and choosing responses suited to the situation. They also use feedback and request frameworks to clarify roles, surface concerns, agree actions and document follow-up, while formal mediation receives introductory coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle recurring workplace friction through supervision, coordination, people support or project delivery. It suits foundation-level learners who want a structured approach to day-to-day conflict conversations.
modules: Ladder of Inference and Fact Checks
RACI Role Clarity in Team Disputes
prerequisites: The course assumes routine workplace experience. No prior conflict-management training is specified.
